milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted bamboo is at spawn-relative (6, 0, -1), requiring ~6 blocks of intentional navigation from spawn. Max distance 3 ensures the player has walked to the bamboo and is facing it, preventing trivial auto-completion from spawn origin.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mossy stone brick stairs begin at spawn-relative (0, -1, -11), requiring navigation through the north corridor. Max distance 4 ensures the player has reached the corridor end and is looking at the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a stone_brick_wall block with a pickaxe drops the stone_brick_wall item into inventory. Player starts with no stone_brick_wall; blocks are placed at (2,-4,-16) in the underground room.

Uses inventory_has because ancient_debris always drops itself when mined with a diamond pickaxe (provided to player). Player starts with no ancient_debris; blocks are at (-3,-4,-18) in the underground room.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with max_count=0 because this is a kill/combat task. The zombie spawns at (0,-4,-17). Detection box covers the entire playable dungeon (±20 blocks from center of activity) to prevent false positives from the mob wandering out. doMobSpawning=false prevents natural spawns causing false negatives.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with max_count=0 because this is a kill/combat task. The spider spawns at (8,-4,-16). Detection box covers the entire playable dungeon to prevent false positives from the mob wandering out. doMobSpawning=false prevents natural spawns causing false negatives.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lit campfire is at spawn-relative (14, -4, -17) in the blue terracotta room. Max distance 4 ensures the player has entered the campfire room and is facing the campfire.

Uses inventory_has because cooked_mutton appears in player inventory after smelting in the furnace (at 15,-4,-17) using coal as fuel. Player starts with raw_mutton and coal but no cooked_mutton, so having 1+ confirms successful cooking.

Uses inventory_has because mining blue_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the item into inventory. Player starts with no blue_terracotta; the campfire room walls (x=11, x=18, z=-14, z=-20) are all blue_terracotta and accessible.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a leather_chestplate (8 leather in chestplate pattern) at the crafting table (17,-4,-17) places the result in inventory. Player starts with 8 leather but no leather_chestplate, so having 1+ confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting end_stone_bricks (4 end_stone in 2x2 pattern yields 4 end_stone_bricks) at the crafting table (17,-4,-17) places the result in inventory. Player starts with 4 end_stone but no end_stone_bricks, so having 1+ confirms successful crafting.
